description: CANNON DOWN RIGGER OPTIMUM ELECTRIC
categoryDescription: Tools & Chandlery from the BLA Australia Edition 15 catalogue.
subCategoryDescription: General Marine Supplies products grouped for AQUAM INSULA Fiji quotation and paid-order fulfilment.
websiteDescription:
Optimum downriggers wirelessly network together giving you control of all of your downriggers with push of a button. They connect with your Humminbird® fish finder and your mobile device for total control andto display trolling data. With the One-Boat Network™, your advanced fishing gear does more than work together. It starts talking to each other wirelessly, to help you find, stay on and land more fish. The full-colour 4” display shows criticaltrolling data right on your downrigger, taking the guess work out of your trolling presentation. The Cannon® mobile app connects to your Optimum downriggers, putting you in total control. Set, cycle or raise weights, access Fish Hawk sensor data…it’s all there at your fingertips. 
Every Optimum downrigger integrates wirelessly with the Fish Hawk™ X4D to give you theinfo you need to troll successfully. You’ll know more than surface water temp and speed.Your Optimum display will also show you the true depth, trolling speed and temperatureat the weight. Through the One-Boat Network, you can also access this data through your mobile device and Humminbird fish finder. 
Features 
• Auto Up allows you to retrieve weights simultaneously 
• across networked downriggers with the push of a button 
• Bottom Tracking keeps your bait presentation at a 
• precise distance off of the bottom 
• Depth Cycling – Cycle your bait within a set depth range 
• Positive Ion Control 
• Waterline Zero 
• Telescopic boom extends from 24” to 53” 
• 250 feet-per-minute retrieval speed 
• 20-lb weight capacity
